title: The override pass reaches every gate, or the refusal says no override lifts it
why: Your gripe, Oct 26: "i imagined override just overrides anything anywhere"; the SendMessage judge (c82) was one gate it could not reach, and there are more.
note: Finding, Oct 26 (c82 thread): the pass is read in one place, guard_core.refuse(). After #645, gates it still cannot reach: the Agent prompt judge in settings.json, the AskUserQuestion agent hook (question reviewer), the pkill/killall entries in the settings.json deny list, the bin/rm and bin/merge shims, and the missing-module deny in hooks/guard.py. Decision owner-override-pass lists them under "Outside every pass" as an orchestrator's call, not your word, so your gripe now governs them. Your own exclusions stay: frozen paths, git env vars, kill of pid 0, 1 or -1, the role and model guards, worktree-home. Fix, needs no answer from you: move each unreachable gate behind refuse(), as #645 did for SendMessage; where that cannot be done (a platform deny list, a shim outside Python), the refusal says no override lifts it, so an override never fails silently. Build with c80 (a refusal offers the exact override line), same files. #645 merged in batch #649 (main 2ad85de6, Oct 27), so this is ready. Port: no; it all lives in claude-settings and installs everywhere. Placed ahead of c77, after c82 (triage, Oct 26): the same silent-override failure, at more gates.
